# The Banyan Tree Company

> Urban banyan tree farm in St. Petersburg, Florida. Young banyan trees, mature centerpiece banyan trees for builders and developers, and banyan tree rescue.

Website: https://www.banyantrees.org/
Phone: 727-644-9200
Location: St. Petersburg, Florida, United States

## Services (as announced July 2, 2020)
- Young banyan trees available direct to your door.
- Mature centerpiece banyan trees for builders and developers.
- Banyan tree rescue — call 727-644-9200.
- All purchases support the donation of banyan trees to local governments for placement in public parks and spaces.
